confidence_notes: I based the restaurant meal, cappuccino and draft beer prices on one web search. It found cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo figures as of June 2026, CityCost, Whereandwhen and ExpatExchange) that broadly agree: an inexpensive meal is about 12.4 to 12.5 EUR, a mid-range meal for two is about 41 to 52 EUR, a cappuccino is about 1.5 to 2 EUR and a 0.5 L domestic draft beer is about 2 to 2.6 EUR. I converted these to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR, worked out from the 18 Nov 2026 RBA cross rates (0.6720 USD and 0.6115 EUR per AUD). I did not search cocktail or wine prices. Those two are model estimates based on local price levels compared with beer: wine at about 3 EUR a glass and cocktails at about 8 EUR, so they are less certain. The accommodation figures are general-knowledge estimates for July, when the heat makes it shoulder or low season in Seville. I did not check any booking sites, so these are the most uncertain anchors. The FX rate of 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026 came from a search summary of RBA data, not from opening the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Similar to other mid-sized southern Spanish tourist cities such as Valencia and Malaga. Food and drink are generally a little cheaper than in Madrid or Barcelona.
